newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Summit proposes one for four bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Summit proposes one for four bonus issue.

text.p: Investment firm SM Summit Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had proposed a bonus issue of one new ordinary share for every four existing shares held.

"The purpose of the bonus issue is to enlarge the capital base of the company to reflect the increase in operating business and asset base of the company and its subsidiaries," SM Summit said in a statement.
Subject to the approvals of the stock exchange and the shareholders, SM Summit will capitalise Singapore $3.75 million from its share premium account to pay in full for the bonus shares to be issued.
On Tuesday, the company reported an interim profit of S$3.55 million, a rise of 86 percent.
